description: Ohm's law for one passive resistor. Give any two of voltage (volts), current (amperes), resistance (ohms) and power (watts). The other two come back as exact rationals. A third or fourth value is checked and rejected when it disagrees. Zero volts across a positive resistance is a dead circuit. Voltage across zero ohms, or voltage with zero current, is rejected. Power and resistance are accepted only when both square roots are rational. SI units, no prefixes. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ohm-law
